epistemic_scope: Primary-source and original-paper audit only. No model download, local inference, German listening test, latency benchmark, target-VPS execution, Trigger-4 integration, or runtime acceptance was observed in this objective.

candidate_findings.role: German-capable realtime speech-native foundation; not by itself proven true full-duplex
observed_facts: Official source lists German among 19 speech-input languages and among 10 speech-output languages.
Official source describes realtime audio/video interaction, natural turn-taking, and immediate text or speech responses.
Official model card publishes German speech-generation results, so German speech support is more than a generic multilingual text claim.
candidate_findings.next_gate: Use only as a German-capability foundation/baseline until target-runtime duplex and latency behavior is measured.

candidate_findings.role: Native full-duplex interaction architecture with asynchronous interaction/thinking layers
candidate_findings.runtime_footprint: Official model card recommends at least 8 NVIDIA H20 GPUs for low-latency deployment at current optimization level; realtime serving uses a modified vLLM/Qwen3-Omni stack and CUDA GPUs.
observed_facts: Paper/source separates a low-latency interaction layer from an asynchronous pluggable thinking/tool layer.
Released weights include Thinker and Talker and the public serving stack is available.
Qwen3-Omni foundation explicitly supports German speech input/output, but this does not prove the DuplexOmni finetune preserves German realtime speech quality.
Current hardware recommendation makes it unsuitable for automatic resident-VPS promotion without a hardware receipt and a materially smaller/quantized runtime path.
candidate_findings.next_gate: Do not download the 70.5 GB checkpoint blindly. First compare actual clay-direct-dev GPU/RAM/VRAM receipt against the >=8xH20 low-latency recommendation; if hardware is insufficient, preserve as architecture donor and test smaller Qwen3-Omni/modular paths instead.

candidate_findings.source_repo: OpenBMB/MiniCPM-o (repository redirects at audit time; exact redirected head not pinned)
candidate_findings.runtime_footprint: Official project material describes 9B total parameters; model table reports approximately 19 GB GPU for the standard model, 10 GB for GGUF and 11 GB for AWQ variants.
observed_facts: Official project material describes full-duplex multimodal live streaming and local demos.
Realtime speech conversation is explicitly described as bilingual English/Chinese.
Project limitations include unstable speech output and mixed English/Chinese in omni mode.
candidate_findings.next_gate: No German production benchmark until upstream or local evidence demonstrates German speech input/output quality; use as full-duplex architecture/runtime reference only.

candidate_findings.code_license: MIT for Python/client, Apache for Rust backend
candidate_findings.runtime_footprint: Official FAQ/source says PyTorch requires a significant GPU, approximately 24 GB class; MLX local inference is tested on MacBook Pro M3 and supports quantized variants.
observed_facts: Official FAQ explicitly says Moshi only speaks English and should not be expected to work fully in other languages.
Streaming Mimi codec frame latency is documented as 80 ms.
Inference stacks exist for PyTorch, MLX and Rust/Candle.
candidate_findings.next_gate: Do not spend German production benchmark budget on stock Moshi; retain for full-duplex timing/cancellation architecture comparison unless a German finetune is independently pinned.

observed_facts: Official README states VITA-1.5 supports English and Chinese.
Official README reports upstream end-to-end speech interaction latency around 1.5 s; this is not F2 target evidence.
candidate_findings.next_gate: No German production promotion without a German-capable successor or finetune.

candidate_findings.role: Streaming speech-to-speech and duplex state-prediction architecture reference
observed_facts: Official source describes chunk-wise streaming input, streaming AR speech output and chunk-level state prediction for duplex dialogue.
Inference code and model weights are published, but the audited primary surfaces do not establish German speech support.
candidate_findings.next_gate: Treat as architecture donor unless a pinned German-capable checkpoint is found.

cross_candidate_conclusions: No audited native full-duplex family receives Frankenstein German production-voice credit from source evidence alone.
Moshi and MiniCPM-o are disqualified from stock German production promotion by explicit language limitations, despite strong full-duplex value as architecture references.

DuplexOmni is the most interesting native-full-duplex research candidate because its Qwen3-Omni foundation explicitly supports German speech input/output and its interaction/thinking split maps well to Frankenstein's fast interaction plus deeper tool/reasoning architecture.

However, DuplexOmni-specific German preservation is unverified and its current low-latency hardware recommendation (>=8 NVIDIA H20) makes it a poor default resident candidate until actual target hardware and smaller-runtime options are measured.
The near-term production hypothesis remains the modular German-first pipeline; native full duplex should remain a parallel architecture lane, not replace it on source claims.

FD-Bench (arXiv:2507.19040) reports that evaluated open-source full-duplex systems still struggle under frequent interruptions and noise, reinforcing that barge-in robustness must be measured rather than inferred from the full-duplex label.
next_exact_action: Re-enter the authorized clay-direct-dev bridge and obtain a hardware/RAM/VRAM roundtrip receipt before any heavyweight DuplexOmni download; use that receipt to falsify or admit native-full-duplex runtime candidates.
